h: Victorian streets, a famous hill and a big bounce
p: Telford's location makes it a superb base for a family weekend in Shropshire, and an inflatable session fits nicely around the bigger attractions nearby. It's worth booking a slot early in the day, then heading out once everyone's worn out the worst of their fidgets. Socks, layers and a water bottle are the main things to remember, and a spare top won't hurt either if anyone gets carried away on the racing.

The Ironbridge Gorge Museums are the obvious partner. Blists Hill Victorian Town is a recreated Victorian street with costumed characters, old shops and even a bank where you can swap your money for old-style coins to spend on site. Enginuity is the hands-on design and technology centre, great for kids who like to build, pull levers and see how things work.

For a breath of fresh air, the Wrekin is the distinctive hill that dominates the skyline west of Telford, and the climb to the top is rewarded with views across the county. Closer to home, the Southwater area of Telford town centre has restaurants, a cinema and the library, while Telford Centre covers your shopping needs. Aviation fans can head to RAF Museum Midlands at Cosford, which is free to enter and packed with historic aircraft. With so much within a short drive, a bounce in Telford can easily turn into a full weekend. Ironbridge itself, with its riverside pubs, tearooms and the famous iron bridge spanning the Severn, is a lovely place to finish with a wander as the sun goes down.
